name: CallAttempt
description: Private call-preparation record owned by a coordinator. Local draft fields support review; approval and provider lifecycle fields are server-reserved and never represent a remote action until a separately authorized phase.

demo_marker.description: Server-controlled marker for the one authorized RepairReady demonstration; empty for ordinary preparation drafts

repair_job_id.description: ID of the owner-created RepairJob this preparation record belongs to

recipient_name.description: Recipient name copied from the selected repair job for local review

recipient_phone.description: Canonical recipient phone copied from the saved repair job, in +countrycode and digits format

recipient_region.description: Provider recipient region reserved for an explicitly approved dispatch; empty in local preparation drafts and never guessed by the browser

recipient_locale.description: Provider recipient locale reserved for an explicitly approved dispatch; empty in local preparation drafts and never guessed by the browser

preparation_purpose.description: Local purpose statement for the proposed preparation conversation; no diagnosis, sales, scheduling, or promise

question_outline.description: Serialized local question outline for review, with one question per line

request_snapshot.description: Serialized, minimized snapshot of the saved operator-entered preparation context used for review and any future server request; no secrets, transcripts, or provider response

idempotency_key.description: Durable local request key reserved for one future provider submission; generated once for this preparation record

lifecycle_status.description: Local prepared label or a server-recorded provider lifecycle state; local draft saving may only write prepared

approval_state.description: Approval state reserved for server authorization. Local preparation saving may only write not_approved and cannot authorize a real call

approved_recipient_phone.description: Server-reserved exact recipient phone approved for one future test call; empty in preparation drafts

approved_at.description: Server-reserved timestamp for explicit approval; empty in preparation drafts

approval_expires_at.description: Server-reserved expiry timestamp for explicit approval; empty in preparation drafts

provider_call_id.description: Server-reserved CALL-E call identifier saved only after a provider submission is accepted; empty in preparation drafts

provider_status.description: Server-reserved sanitized CALL-E lifecycle state such as queued, in_progress, completed, failed, or canceled; empty in preparation drafts

submitted_at.description: Server-reserved timestamp recorded only after a provider call identifier is accepted; empty in preparation drafts

completed_at.description: Server-reserved provider completion timestamp when returned and safely validated; empty in preparation drafts

safe_error_category.description: Server-reserved bounded category for a sanitized provider or persistence failure; never raw response text

safe_result_summary.description: Server-reserved bounded summary of safe result metadata only, never a transcript, phone number, credential, or raw provider response

review_note.description: Safe local review or error note; never a provider response, transcript, access code, or secret
